note: Canonical Slice 2 scenario (scenario design agreed 2026-10-15). Three consecutive planned charges; strict recipes; single non-preemptive crane with a FIFO queue and player priority reordering. FEASIBILITY: feasible at landed values (grab 2.0 m3, deadlines 240/270/300, horizon 300) — win proven by an honest stacked-material mirror run re-derived 2026-10-18 after the d3614e6 parameter landing; expected_outputs below are frozen from that verified run. Earlier expectation blocks (ready@172 at deadlines 180/195/210) were ad37d61-era artifacts and are superseded. Values are game-balance placeholders pending SME calibration, EXCEPT bulk densities which are engineering-estimate ranges (typical published bands, form/packing dependent — never presented as universal facts in info-cards).

provenance_labels.source-backed: may appear in player-facing info-cards as industry fact

crane_task.rule: non-preemptive: priority change affects only queued tasks; a running task completes its cycle

prepared_charge.recipe_rule: strict fixed grade list, required usable tonnage per grade, no substitution in v1

dri_charge_material.note: thin, defined now, implemented in Slice 3

competing_task.note: yard reorganization task enters the queue while C2 deadline approaches — crane contention pressure

scenario.feasibility_check: STATUS: feasible at landed values. At grab 2.0 m3 x ~550 kg/m3 the hms 30t move = 7 grabs (14 ticks), bushing 15t = 4 grabs (8 ticks). Honest plan enqueues each charge's moves after their stacks are filled by receiving: C1 41/86 -> ready@101 < 240; C2 141/186 -> ready@201 < 270; C3 231/276 -> ready@291 <= 300. Verified by mirror run 2026-10-18 (see expected_outputs). Historical audit trail: at pre-decision grab 0.8 m3 the scenario was infeasible (hand arithmetic, 2026-10-15); the landed grab 2.0 / deadlines 240-270-300 combination is the first that admits an honest winning plan at cadence 2.

bulk_density_kg_m3.note: bulk density depends on scrap form and packing conditions; values are configurable demo placeholders pending Yasser SME calibration, not universal facts

win_condition: 3 consecutive charges ready before deadline (win=True at landed values); failure path cause-attributed via negative control (no charge tasks -> insufficient_usable_tonnage)

player_plan.note: charge tasks only from stacked material (receiving precedes charging; the reservation guard refuses unstacked tonnage); each charge's moves enqueued once, hms-then-bushing per charge

C3.note: deadline 300 = scenario end; no failure recorded

expected_outputs.note: expectations frozen from the verified mirror run 2026-10-18 (mirror/slice2_mirror.py __main__, fresh process): win True; C1 ready@101, C2@201, C3@291. Sweep evidence: grab 1.0 at 180/195/210 fails all charges; grab 1.0 at 240-270-300 fails C2; grab 1.5 fails C3 readiness; deadlines <=270 fail C3 (C3 floor ~ready@291). C3 slack of 9 ticks is tight — flagged for Yasser's SME calibration, not silently widened.

priority_action.measured_effect: at the landed deadlines the reclaim runs in a crane-idle window (ticks ~102-111) and does not delay any charge; the win holds with and without the priority verb — recorded honestly, the crane-contention pressure is inert at these deadlines
